customManagers.description: Third-party service image tags pinned in the config SSOT. Dependabot cannot see these: it parses Dockerfiles, not arbitrary YAML (#974).

Vendored operators in cluster_bootstrap: `version` with its `source.repo`, the GitHub release `make sync-operators` fetches (#694). The version line and the source are adjacent by contract, and a CI step fails a bump that did not regenerate the manifest.
The Node version pre-commit's node hooks run on. Pinned so a hook environment never depends on the Node index of the day (#3070).

packageRules.description: Default: group patch+minor into one weekly PR. Majors stay individual — the review question is different, and burying one in a group is how it merges unread.

Galaxy collections in infra/ansible/requirements.yml, pinned exactly (ANSIBLE-070). Patch+minor arrive as one weekly PR; majors stay individual. After a merge each controller runs `make setup-ansible`, and `make provision`/`make deploy` refuse one that has not.

Headscale. Its clients are the Tailscale daemons on 8 nodes, pinned separately and NOT tracked here — so a server bump can outrun them. It is also the bootstrap dependency for the whole mesh: if the control plane rejects the clients, the VPN used to reach the VPS and fix it is the thing that broke. Never grouped, never silent.
prBodyNotes: **Bootstrap dependency.** Check the release notes for client-protocol changes before merging, and be ready to reach the VPS over its public IP rather than the mesh.

packageRules.description: Postgres. A major is not an upgrade — it is a dump and restore, because the on-disk format changes and the new binary refuses the old data directory. Renovate cannot know that and would offer it as one more bump.
prBodyNotes: **Not an in-place upgrade.** A Postgres major needs pg_dump on the old version and restore on the new one. Confirm a verified backup exists (`make backup-coverage ENV=prod`) before starting.

packageRules.description: Authelia. It guards everything behind ForwardAuth, Argo CD included. A failed schema migration locks the operator out of the tools needed to roll it back.
prBodyNotes: **Locks you out if it goes wrong.** Verify a current backup of `authelia-data` first; the session/WebAuthn store is in it.

packageRules.description: Grafana. The platform's tier enforcement and token hygiene depend on this version's OAuth behaviour: the role path re-run on an empty groups list, UserInfo as the groups source, and the opaque-token warning that leaked to Loki.
prBodyNotes: **Re-verify the identity model.** Deploy to staging, sign in as a `users` member, then run `make auth-review ENV=staging` and `poetry run pytest tests/test_oauth_tokens_not_logged.py`; read lessons 457, 461 and 463 before merging.

packageRules.description: Vendored operators. A bump edits only `version`: run `make sync-operators` on the PR branch and commit the manifest, or CI stays red. Never grouped, because each operator's CRDs change on their own terms.
prBodyNotes: **Regenerate before merging.** Run `make sync-operators` on this branch and commit the manifest; the `Check vendored operator manifests` step stays red until you do. Read the CRD changes, then validate on staging with `make deploy-k8s ENV=staging`.
